Poke ball - projectile/item drops 
Great ball - projectile/item drops
Ultra Ball - projectile/item drops

Premier Ball - commemorative item

Net Ball - replaces barbed hook
Lure ball - replaces dressed spinner
Dive Ball - replaces trapped bobber
Level Ball - replaces corked bobber

Heal Ball - projectile/ Has a 25% chance to heal the player after defeating an enemy.
Heavy Ball - projectile/More critical hit chance (adds 4.6% × level).
Master ball - projectile/ Useful against ghosts and armored bugs.

May be purchased from Marlon, Pierre, Dwarf, Krobus, Robin.
You may have to befriend some of them to get them to sell the items.
It's also possible that they appear inside the Mines.
(After first loading up the mod a config file will appear that allows you to adjust any of the abilities and loot item drops. The files are located in the AMF folders.)

Downloads.Description: adds the GS Ball weapon with matching sprite options and normalizes Precision across all 13 weapons to Stardew’s 0–10 scale. Existing ball variants and sprite choices remain.

Poké Ball Objects 2.0.0 converts the classic six decorative balls to Content Patcher, adds shop stock and shared sprite styles, and retains all nine fishing tackle reskins. Apricorn and Hisui machine balls are excluded.
